# FixThePhoto

> > Professional photo retouching and editing services offering Photoshop-based solutions from $0.14 per image across photography, e-commerce, real estate, and specialized markets.

FixThePhoto is a comprehensive photo editing service provider specializing in professional retouching, background removal, color correction, and image manipulation. The platform serves photographers, e-commerce businesses, and content creators with tiered pricing packages and additional resources including free Lightroom presets and AI training datasets.

## Core Services

- [Photo Retouching Services](https://fixthephoto.com): FixThePhoto homepage showcasing professional photo retouching and editing services
- [Post Production Photo Editing](https://fixthephoto.com/post-production-services): Post production photo editing services from $0.2 per photo for photographers
- [Wedding Photo Retouching](https://fixthephoto.com/services/wedding-photo-retouching): Wedding photo editing from $0.14 per image including culling and color correction
- [Product Photo Editing](https://fixthephoto.com/product-retouching-services): E-commerce product retouching and background removal from $0.99 per photo
- [Real Estate Photo Editing](https://fixthephoto.com/real-estate-photo-editing-services): Real estate photo editing with sky replacement and HDR from $1 per image
- [Headshot Retouching](https://fixthephoto.com/headshot-retouching-services): Professional headshot retouching from $5 per image for corporate portraits
